title: Lemon Integrations
tagline: Open frames integrations for daily quizzes and mini-games with XTMP/Morph for Lemon Dapp
description: Lemon is a learning tool that creates quizzes from. any type of input in seconds. Users can learn whatever they want by using flashcards and mini-games. We're built on Morph and wanted to experiment with Frames for this hackathon. So we integrated XTMP with Hono for Converse and Farcaster where users can do daily activities and claim LEMON points (Our game currency)
how_its_made:
Using Hono with Frog. Converse and Dev Warpcast for testing our development.

Our main stack is:
- NextJS
- Typescript
- Tailwindcss
- Viem
- Morph
- Vercel KV (Redis)
- Hono
- XTMP

Our main dapp (lemon.tips) is live with more than 4,000 users. We did this experiment for the ETHGlobal Hackathon : )
